summary: Berlin/Milan fire tower site in Coos County; the register lists the tower gone, and a 2014 hike report found only traces.

facts.status_note: The fire tower is gone; a 2014 hike report found only traces such as a foundation and cement blocks.

access.note: A 2014 hike report describes the old fire warden's road as gated. No source says who owns the land or whether hikers may use the road.

visit.trail_note: A 2014 hike used the old fire warden's road off York Pond Road, which is gated. No tower stands to climb.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says Berlin; the 2014 hike report and a hiking list say Berlin/Milan. The story uses both names.

sources.title: You Are Here: NH Fire Towers

notes_for_editor: No build, staffing or removal date found in any source checked: the register, the NH Family Hikes list, a hiking list, a 2014 hike report, and two web searches. Heights differ: 2,785 ft (NH Family Hikes) against 2,770 ft (hikeoverthehill); both are in the story. Do not confuse with the NHLR Deer Mountain Lookout (US 1575, NH 22) at Pittsburg, which is standing and is a different site. The eastern lookout page for Deer Mountain (Coos) is an empty stub; the other eastern NH Deer Mountain page (deer-mountain.html, with a 1915-16 note) gives no county and was not used. Access level is unknown: the only evidence is one 2014 report that the road was gated, and the land owner is not identified in any source.
